technical_complexity.rationale: Maintaining a ClickHouse fork with compute-storage separation and a cache mesh is deep systems work.

defensibility.rationale: Open-source base is shared and many managed providers exist; the fork may differentiate.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The vendor and several hosts already sell the same wedge.

market_need_then: Rising cost and latency of analytics on object storage and agent workloads per the company and trade write-ups.

outcome_analysis: ObsessionDB is a Fall 2026 YC company by repeat founders from the ClickHouse ecosystem, with named customers on the site including Numia. It competes with the vendor and several managed hosts. No outcome yet; the main risk is dependence on ClickHouse and an open-source base.
